programme_detail_official.description: SECIHTI's 2026 inclusion call bundles three separate targeted-need components: bachelor's scholarships for Mexican women who head the family, supplementary support for Mexican indigenous people who already hold a SECIHTI national postgraduate scholarship, and supplementary support for Mexican people with disabilities who already hold the same postgraduate scholarship. Applications for the 2026 cycle opened on 29 June 2026 and closed on 25 September 2026. Amounts, eligibility detail and selection criteria for each component are published only in the three Términos de Referencia PDFs linked from the convocatoria page.

application_readiness_checklist: Confirm which of the three tracks applies to you — the eligibility rules are entirely different and there is no single combined application
If you are applying to Track B or C, make sure your SECIHTI national postgraduate scholarship is active, because that is the gating condition
Download Formato MBP-MJF and the manual for your track from the convocatoria page before starting
Have your CURP, RFC and proof of Mexican nationality ready
For Track C, have your disability documentation ready; the Términos de Referencia C defines what is accepted
Register or update a bank account in your own name — SECIHTI pays only to accounts in the applicant's name
common_rejection_risks: Applying on the wrong track — the three components are separate competitions with separate Términos de Referencia
Applying to Track B or C without an active SECIHTI national postgraduate scholarship
Missing the window: the 2026 call closed on 25 September 2026 at 23:59 CDMX
Bank account not in the applicant's own name, or not registered before the payment step
Incomplete file after one of the calendar-adjustment Avisos — each Avisos changed dates for one track
estimated_uncovered_costs: Because two of the three components are top-ups rather than full awards, applicants should assume they still need other resources for anything the SECIHTI postgraduate scholarship does not already cover
The amount of the top-up is not readable from the convocatoria page, so no reliable budget figure can be estimated from official sources alone

alerts.message: Only technical programmes completed during 2025 or 2026 qualify. If you finished earlier, this scholarship is closed to you and you should look at Beca Nuevo Milenio or Beca Juan Gómez Millas instead.
Distance, semi-presential, special titulación, postgraduate and post-degree programmes are all excluded, as is anything the institution calls a special study plan. Check before enrolling.
The award covers the regulatory programme length, but the titulación and practice periods do not count unless they are in the curriculum.

submission_workflow: Confirm the 2025 or 2026 technical qualification and RSH band
Choose an accredited institution and a non-excluded programme
Access the FUAS portal with RUT or ClaveÚnica
Submit between 1 and 22 October 2026
Upload documents during the Mineduc document window
Track preselection from 15 January 2027 and allocation results from 10 March 2027

rejected.candidate: Fondo Especial de Créditos Educativos Condonables para Comunidades Negras (FECECN), ICETEX, Colombia
rejected.reason: Targeted at Afro-Colombian/Raizal/Palenquero students without the means to enter higher education, and the 2026-2 window (21 July to 4 September 2026) is already closed — but the instrument is a 'crédito 100% condonable', i.e. a forgivable student loan with a pagaré and guarantee premium, which the brief excludes as a record. Also at high risk of colliding with w2_16 (government x Latin America). Not written.

rejected.candidate: Fondo Álvaro Ulcué Chocué para miembros de los pueblos indígenas, ICETEX, Colombia
rejected.reason: Same as FECECN: a 100% condonable credit (loan), not a scholarship, and the 2026-2 registration window (23 July to 11 August 2026) has closed.

rejected.reason: Window closed 19 May 2026, and this is a regional multi-country mobility scheme explicitly claimed by w2_20 (Latin America regional_multi). Not taken.

rejected.reason: Discovered via search but rejected on source grounds: the page is a private marketing site operated by Grupo Summa on behalf of the municipality, not an official government domain, and the scholarship is commercial (up to 80% tuition at partner private institutions, allocated by enrolment order, not a competitive need-based award).

rejected.candidate: OHCHR Fellowship Programme for Indigenous Peoples and for People of African Descent
rejected.reason: Strong targeted-need awards and genuinely relevant, but both are hosted in Geneva, Switzerland, so the record would be region Europe, not Latin America, and Switzerland is already in the catalogue. The 2026 African-descent call also closed on 15 May 2026.

rejected.candidate: Fundación Carolina 2026-2027|Convocatoria de becas (incl. women in STEM and human-rights-defender targeted programmes)
rejected.reason: The women-in-STEM and human-rights-defender sub-programmes are exactly targeted-need, but the award is administered from Spain (region Europe, Spain already in catalogue) and the 2026-27 window closed on 2 March 2026 (postgraduate) / 9 April 2026 (doctoral). Wrong region for this cell.

rejected.candidate: PRONABEC contests (Beca Generación Bicentenario, Beca 18, Beca Inclusión carreras profesionales, Beca Permanencia, Beca Hijos de Docentes)
rejected.reason: Read the official contests index: the two live contests (Beca Generación Bicentenario, Beca 18) are both listed under 'En proceso' with no open application window, and every targeted-need contest (Beca Inclusión carreras profesionales, Beca Hijos de Docentes, Beca Permanencia) is under 'Concursos finalizados'. No record possible.

rejected.candidate: Beca Residencia Indígena para la educación superior (BRI), JUNAEB, Chile
rejected.reason: On-paper an excellent targeted-need award (indigenous descent accredited by CONADI, up to 60% most vulnerable per RSH, forced to change city; CLP 992,150/yr, CLP 1,301,400 in Magallanes). But the ficha publishes no application window — it only points to the JUNAEB results portal and https://www.junaeb.cl/becas-junaeb/ for the calendar, and every JUNAEB host (www.junaeb.cl, portalbecas, resultadobecas, sinabweb) is unreachable from this environment (ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT in both webfetch and Playwright). With no verifiable open or imminent window this fails the brief's rule that a programme with no confirmable current cycle is not a record.

Read in full. Amounts are published (básica CLP 100,550; media CLP 208,280; superior CLP 654,600 in up to 10 instalments) and eligibility is clean (CONADI-accredited indigenous descent, RSH up to 60%, grade 5.0). Rejected only because the ficha shows no application window and the JUNAEB calendar host is unreachable, so I cannot confirm an open or imminent cycle.

rejected.candidate: Beca de Integración Territorial (BIT), JUNAEB, Chile
rejected.reason: Read in full. Strong geographic targeting (Aysén, Magallanes, Palena, Chiloé, Rapa Nui, Juan Fernández; 80% most vulnerable per RSH) with published amounts (18.7 UTM/year in 10 instalments plus travel allowances of 18.65 UTM for Isla de Pascua, 3.73 UTM for Juan Fernández, 5.79 UTM for Los Lagos/Aysén/Magallanes). Same blocker as BRI: no application window on the ficha and the JUNAEB calendar host is unreachable.

rejected.candidate: Other JUNAEB territorial and harm-targeted scholarships surfaced on the official ChileAtiende catalogue (Beca Residencia Insular BRINS, Beca Magallanes y Antártica Chilena BMA, Beca Patagonia Aysén BPA, Beca Polimetales BPOL, Beca Presidente de la República BPR, Beca de Apoyo Universidad del Mar BUMAR)
rejected.reason: All read on the official catalogue listing page. Every one is JUNAEB-administered and none publishes an application window on its ficha, so all fail the same unreachable-JUNAEB-calendar test. Two are additionally out of scope on their own terms: BUMAR renewal is automatic and no longer postulable, and BMES is explicitly 'un beneficio no postulable'.

rejected.candidate: Beca Vocación de Profesor (BVP), Mineduc, Chile
rejected.reason: Read in full and it is genuinely open (postulación 1-22 October 2026 for admisión 2027), so it would have made a strong record — but it is off-theme for this cell. The official ficha states plainly 'La beca no considera tu condición socioeconómica': eligibility is being a pedagogy, licenciatura or newly-licensed student, with a three-year teaching bond. That is a subject/profession-targeted award, not a targeted-need one, and it belongs to the level or subject cells. Left for another cell rather than filed under 'targeted'.

rejected.candidate: Beca Juan Gómez Millas (BJGM) and Beca Bicentenario, Mineduc, Chile
rejected.reason: Deliberately not taken. Both are need-based tuition schemes with the same gate as Beca Nuevo Milenio (70% lowest income per RSH) and overlapping amounts (up to CLP 1,150,000 for BJGM; Bicentenario also funds the same 250 disability places). Writing them would have padded the count with near-duplicates of a record I already hold.

rejected.candidate: Beca de Mantención para la Educación Superior (BMES) and Beca de Acceso a TIC, JUNAEB, Chile
rejected.reason: Excluded on the brief's own terms: the catalogue states BMES is 'un beneficio no postulable' (renewal only) and the TIC benefit is 'no postulable', has no appeal process, and is in-kind equipment rather than a funding award.

rejected.candidate: Programa Becas Fondo Cesantía Solidario, SENCE, Chile
rejected.reason: The official ficha states plainly 'La postulación se encuentra cerrada'. Also a training-course subsidy rather than a scholarship.

rejected.candidate: CONICYT/ANID Becas Chile — Concurso Magíster en el Extranjero and Concurso Doctorado en el Extranjero, Chile
rejected.reason: The catalogue states 'No hay convocatorias disponibles para el 2026' for the master's call and that the doctoral postulation closed on 19 May 2026. Closed, and in any case a general state research-scholarship programme rather than a targeted-need one (and the cell I told the board I was avoiding).
